:::{.callout-warning collapse=true}
### 'Database' errors

MFA uses a relational database during alignment.
On some platforms and environments, the database can generate errors.

There are two database engine options supported by MFA: PostgreSQL or SQLite.
You can choose between these two options by using the *Use PostGres* checkbox 
under the *MFA Options* of the layer configuration.

If you see errors relating to the 'database', try changing the *Use PostGres* setting;
i.e. if it's un-ticked, then tick it, or if it's ticked, then un-tick it.


#### pg_ctl: could not start server

If you have *Use PostGres* ticked, and you see an error in the log saying:

```
pg_ctl: could not start server
```

... this may be because the full path name of the database file is too long. 
The database file, in part, includes the Participant ID. If the Participant's ID
is quite long, this may be the cause of the error.

To work around this problem, change the Participant ID to something shorter.

:::
